South Korea, US Discuss Chip Investments Amid Tariff Concerns

South Korea and the United States are engaged in discussions regarding semiconductor investments in the US, a Seoul official stated on Friday. These discussions are part of broader bilateral talks between the two nations. The official was responding to inquiries about whether planned US tariffs on chips were impacting ongoing investment negotiations. The specific details of the investments or the exact nature of the tariff concerns were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
